messages:
Alex: Morning roll-call — quick status for GPUs across regions? specifically need headroom notes for AMS, SIN and us-west-2 + any quota tickets pending. (What you did / blockers / today)
Maya: Did a small reclaim in ams-b last night, freed ~6 GPUs from stalled jobs. No blockers. Today: will open a quota request for ams-b if numbers don't hold after the next hour.
Jun: us-west-2 looking healthy. Dropped a transient autoscale policy that was causing small cold starts (fixed). Blocker: one model rollout is pegging vram on p4d-24s, tracking with @Priya.
Priya: Investigating that model's batch sizing — suspected bad batch config. I ran a quick trace, attaching top lines below.
Priya: ```
2026-03-17T07:02:13Z model-x deploy: gpu0 92% mem, 12 GB free
2026-03-17T07:02:20Z batch_size=32 -> OOM on p4d-24s
2026-03-17T07:02:32Z retry batch_size=16 -> ok
```
Priya: Plan: pin model-x rollout to quantized variant on p4d until I land config. ETA 2-3 hrs. If anyone sees a surge, please @me.
Maya: FYI opened ticket INF-4321 to request +8 GPUs in ams-b (reason: scheduled batch evals + reclaimed slot runway). Pinged infra-sales for soft quota bump.
Alex: @InfraBot can you post current reserved vs free per AZ snapshot?
InfraBot: Snapshot generated: reserved/free per AZ (approx): ams-a 12/4, ams-b 20/2, sin-1 8/6, us-west-2 40/12. Hotspots: ams-b low free headroom. https://internal.tools/quotas/3723456789
Jun: Quick question — any planned spot-eviction drills today? want to avoid scheduling long evals in us-west-2 if so.
Alex: No formal drill today, but ops will do a small targeted eviction test in sin-1 around 09:30 UTC. Avoid scheduling >30min jobs in sin-1 09:15-09:45 UTC.
Maya: If ams-b doesn't stabilize, suggest we redirect nightly evals to sin-1 for tonight. Can someone change the routing policy for the eval-campaign? @Jun?
Jun: I can flip a routing rule. Suggest adding a temporary route priority: eval-campaign -> sin-1 > ams-b. I'll queue the change and post the deploy bot message when done.
Alex: Thanks. Also, heads-up: there's a leave rotation change next week — will post new on-call shift so people know who picks up midnight provisioning. No action now.
Priya: One more blocker: my PR for better batch autoscaling needs one more review (PR#2897). If someone can glance quickly, I can merge and redeploy the policy today.
Maya: lgtm on PR2897, will add a quick comment and approve in ~10m.
Jun: Approved and merged. I'll monitor metrics after the rollout.
Alex: Great. Summary: Maya watching ams-b (INF-4321), Priya handling model-x pin + PR, Jun doing routing change + watch us-west-2, infra will avoid big jobs in sin-1 during small eviction test. Ping here if you need help. :thumbsup:
InfraBot: Reminder — quota auto-escalation window opens in 3h for ams-b (ticket INF-4321). If manual escalation needed, escalate to sales@redwood.com.
Maya: acknowledged. I'll be online for the escalation window.
Alex: Excellent. If nothing else, that's it from me. Post any follow-ups here so we have a trace.
